Sara / Chloe — quick technical notes to include in the pack (I added these under the regression plan section):

- Regression approach: we run a two-tier regression for any model change affecting scoring or tokenizer behavior:
  * Smoke: deterministic unit tests + sanity prompts on a synthetic suite (~500 prompts).
  * Statistical: evaluation on labeled holdout sets + production-sampled prompts (~5k–20k examples depending on release class).

- Sampling: production-sampled prompts are privacy-scrubbed (prefix-only) and stratified by route and latency bucket to preserve representativeness. We can provide aggregate distributions rather than raw content.

- Metrics: we report token-level latency, top-level task metrics (e.g., F1/ROUGE where applicable), hallucination rate measured by a human-sampled audit, and drift indicators (embedding centroid shift).

- Versioning: every release has an immutable model digest and a rollout tag. For Dedicated/Private deployments we capture the quantization profile and kernel set as additional metadata.

- Retention & access: test logs and audit records are retained 12 months by default (configurable per contract) with role-based access control; exportable as CSV and linked to evidence IDs in the traceability matrix.

I'll attach a short appendix with command examples for reproducing the regression run (redacted for customer data).

—Aditya
